items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: David Jones played at the La Vida with me, too.

ctx.x: No, I said Alcon played with me at La Vida after Lee Connors left my Chicago. Him and John Marrero went to Chicago. And then Alcon and George Gano coming.
Now was that after, was that after Collins worked at the Astoria with Davy Jones? Or do you know?
And that was, um, oh, matter of fact, David Jones played at the La Vida with me, too.
